# Voice and Tone

## Voice (constant)

- **Plain.** Use the simplest word that fits.
- **Specific.** Name the object and the action ("Delete project", not "Delete this").
- **Calm.** No exclamation marks. No alarmism in success messages.

## Tone (varies)

| Surface          | Tone        | Example                                              |
|------------------|-------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| Confirmation     | Direct      | "Delete project? This cannot be undone."             |
| Error            | Apologetic  | "Something went wrong on our side. Please try again."|
| Success          | Understated | "Saved."                                             |
| Empty state      | Encouraging | "No projects yet. Start by creating one."            |

## Avoid

- "Oops!", "Whoops!", and similar
- Blaming language ("You forgot...", "You haven't...")
- Vague verbs ("Submit", "Process")
